images.note: 2 mm (147 GHz) dust continuum image of NGC 1333 IRAS 4B. The file is a panel-only crop of the right source in the paper Fig. 1. Peak continuum flux 0.244 Jy/beam; contours are 5 evenly spaced levels (1 level = 0.060 Jy/beam) from 3 sigma_cont (1.3 mJy/beam) to the peak. White circle is the peak continuum pixel used for spectral extraction; synthesized beam (1.46x1.62 arcsec, PA 27.7 deg for LSB) in the lower-left. Observed with NOEMA in C configuration (12C-E023 / 12C-N007), LO 145.250 GHz.
